error.cannot_connect: Could not read relays 1 and 2 from the iTach.
error.travel_times_required: Enter both travel times to enable positioning or daily calibration.

init.title: Calibrate projector screen
init.description: Make sure the screen’s travel area is clear and you can see both physical limits. Start raises the screen. You’ll mark the endpoints as the screen reaches them.

start.title: Set the starting top position
start.description: Watch the screen rise. When it has stopped fully raised, mark the top to begin measuring the descent.

initial_top.title: Set the bottom position
initial_top.description: Tap as soon as the screen reaches its fully lowered position. This records the lower time and starts raising the screen.

bottom.title: Set the top position
bottom.description: Tap as soon as the screen reaches its fully raised position. This records the raise time and stops the screen.

save.title: Review travel times
save.description: You can adjust either measurement before saving. The screen’s current position will be set to 100% (fully raised).

abort.screen_busy: The screen is moving or another calibration is open. Stop the screen or finish the other calibration first.
abort.motion_disabled: Screen motion is disabled. Enable it before calibrating.
abort.calibration_expired: Calibration was stopped or timed out. Open Configure to start again.
abort.invalid_measurement: The measured travel time was too short or too long. Start again and mark each endpoint as it is reached.
abort.calibration_failed: The iTach did not confirm a command. If the screen is still moving, use Stop or the wall control.
